name: skillbook
description: Dojo Mojo's skillbook — agent skills: own skills, the ported pstack pack, and pointers to dyegolara's published auth skills.

scripts.skills:install: npx skills@latest add dyegolara/lnurl-auth-agents --skill lnurl-auth && npx skills@latest add dyegolara/nostr-auth-agents --skill nostr-auth
scripts.verify: npm run verify:publishing && npm run verify:upstream -- --report-only && npm run verify:pstack
scripts.install:pstack: npm --prefix skills/pstack/poteto-mode/scripts install --no-audit --no-fund && node --input-type=module -e "import('./skills/pstack/poteto-mode/scripts/bootstrap.ts').then(({ writeInstallKey }) => writeInstallKey('full'))"
scripts.test:pstack: npm run install:pstack && npm --prefix skills/pstack/poteto-mode/scripts test
scripts.typecheck:pstack: npm run install:pstack && npm --prefix skills/pstack/poteto-mode/scripts run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:copilot-review-smart && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:pstack
